notes.title: Bug Fix / Bugs and image fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you to the players for their great support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44668827/375d92718e9b7124b8df94272b52c5b6546bfddb.jpg

We fixed some major issues;

 Fixed save import system and freezing issues.
 Changed the sound levels of some Chapters.
 Improvements have been made to make players wait on the transition screen less.
 Fixed crashing issue




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44668827/58b73fb8fa0673fcf5fc57d6b4c6eba145c86b45.jpg


You can follow us on our social media. For quick feedback, you can join our Discord account and ask questions as you wish.
Thanks again for supporting us.
